violaciones.description: Ensure <meta name="viewport"> does not disable text scaling and zooming
violaciones.help: Zooming and scaling must not be disabled

any.message: user-scalable=no on <meta> tag disables zooming on mobile devices

nodes.html: <meta name="viewport" content="viewport-fit=cover, width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, minimum-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
nodes.failureSummary:
Fix any of the following:
  user-scalable=no on <meta> tag disables zooming on mobile devices
